name: h1r_edge_s5_rope4d_smoke
title: Biohub H1R Edge S5 RoPE4D Smoke
purpose: Two-step S5 plumbing smoke for the rope4d positional-encoding arm (H1R_EDGE_POS_ENCODING=rope4d). Verifies the spliced h1r_rope4d module registers for the trainer cell, the public checkpoint still loads strictly with the rotary twin installed, one fp16-autocast train/eval step through the rotated attention, the frozen-detector drift assertion, and that config_h1r_s5_rope4d.json / edge_predictor_best_h1r_s5_rope4d.pth are exported with the rope keys the inference patch needs. No submission.

edits.cell_match: Fail fast instead of silently running volumetric inference on CPU

edits.cell_match: Independent audit for the frozen frame-retention probe

diagnostic_reason: Two-step plumbing smoke of the rope4d arm: proves the GPU autocast path through the rotary attention, both Zh001r mounts, the frozen-detector drift assertion and a zero-epoch link_top1/candidate_recall baseline under the rotation. Its edge_predictor_best.pth is NOT for deployment.
